text:
If you were hoping for a bright, easy Friday, Burlington has started out more gray than advertised, with mostly cloudy skies and a comfortable 68 so far. The temperature is right on track, though, and the afternoon should stay dry with a high around 69. Expect the north wind to become the main character, gusting around 15 mph and making the waterfront feel sharper than the thermometer suggests. On the lake, waves build from around a foot to 1 to 3 feet, so keep smaller boats close to shore.

Clouds fill back in tonight with a chilly low near 44 and continued north wind, while Saturday looks sunny, dry, and cooler, topping out around 63. The air is clean, but the water is still 67, so a late-season dip is doable. Take the walk this afternoon, but bring a layer for the lake and be off the broad water before evening.
